description: Find the best air fryer under ₹3,000 in India with real wattage and capacity comparisons, practical trade-offs, and one popular model to avoid.
short_desc: Five genuinely useful budget fryers, compared without the preset hype.
keywords: cheap air fryer for two people

headings.text: What actually matters in an air fryer under ₹3,000

cta.headline: Choose by heater and basket—not preset count
cta.sub: Compare live prices, warranty coverage and basket size before ordering. Prices below ₹3,000 move frequently during sales.

faq.q: Is an air fryer under ₹3,000 worth buying?
faq.a: Yes for one or two people, provided it has at least 1200W heating, a 3L or larger basket, and accessible warranty support. Expect manual controls and lighter construction.

faq.q: What capacity air fryer is enough for two people?
faq.a: A 3-4L basket is usually enough for two portions of fries, 6-8 small chicken pieces, or a batch of paneer tikka. Do not fill the basket to the rim.

faq.q: How much electricity does a 1200W air fryer use?
faq.a: At full power, 20 minutes uses about 0.4 kWh. At an electricity rate of ₹8 per unit, that is roughly ₹3.20 per cooking cycle.

faq.q: Can a cheap air fryer make crispy samosas?
faq.a: Yes. Preheat for 3 minutes, brush or spray a thin layer of oil, cook in one layer at 180-190°C, and turn halfway through.

faq.q: Is a digital air fryer better than a manual one?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Digital presets add convenience, but heater power, airflow and basket loading affect browning more than the control panel.
